record.intent: Walk the whole first-project path for real: make a project, ask whether it holds together, add a module, get it wrong once and see what the toolchain says, put it right, build what was checked, and ask the project what it now contains.

steps.text:
module greeting
    layer: domain
    version: 0.1.0
    intent: "Greet the person using this project, by name."
    exports: [greet]
    requires: []
    uses: []

    soft_requires: none
    runtime_only_requires: none
    deferred_requires: none
    exports_helpers: none
nerve greet :: DOMAIN
    kind: FUNCTION
    visibility: PUBLIC
    intent: "Return a greeting for the name it is given."
    expects: "A name, as text."
    guarantees: "Returns a greeting that contains the name."
    forbids: none
    evaluates_at: FUNCTION_BOUNDARY
    provides: none
    returns: none
    raises: none
    interface: none
    latency_ms: none
    depends_on: none
    internal: none
    expected_exceptions: none
    consumes_via_dict: none
    declares_attributes: none
    covered_by: none
    ---
    def greet(name: str) -> str:
        """Return a greeting for the name it is given."""
        return f"Hello, {name}!"
